title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WeightSensor
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WeightSensor. A class to describe a sensor that measures mass. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. NOTE: the SAREF4AGRI v2.1.1 ontology does not declare a dedicated saref4agri:Property named individual for 'weight'/'mass'; 'observes' is therefore left as free text rather than constrained to the ten declared named individuals. A weight sensor may weigh livestock (body mass) or harvested produce (yield mass).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WeightSensor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

observes.description: Property/Relationship. saref:observes. A free-text label for the quantity observed, e.g. 'Weight' (live animal mass) or the IRI of the s4agri:Yield named individual when weighing harvested produce, since v2.1.1 declares no dedicated saref4agri:Property named individual for mass/weight.

hasFeatureOfInterest.description: Relationship. saref:hasFeatureOfInterest. The Animal, AnimalGroup or Crop this measurement is about.

value.description: Property. saref:hasValue. The last mass measurement reported by the sensor.

unitCode.description: Property. saref:isMeasuredIn. The unit of measure for 'value' (e.g. 'KGM' kilogram).

dateObserved.description: Property. The date and time this measurement was made.
